svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: RL + Test-Time Optimization on a Real-Time Time Series
svg.desc: A streaming time series is sliced into small episodes by a sliding window. Each episode is passed to a pre-trained RL policy and a test-time optimizer, which adapts the policy on the fly. The action is applied to the environment, a reward is observed, and the loop repeats.
